column_semantics: The schedule has a single position-level Interest Rate (2) column. For PIK investments, that column prints the all-in stated coupon/rate, with the PIK component disclosed in the same cell as a parenthetical or as a PIK label for a 100% PIK rate; it does not provide separate cash and PIK rate columns.

rationale: The March 31, 2026 schedule does not have separate Cash and PIK interest-rate columns. Its header provides a separate Reference Rate and Spread (2) column and a single Interest Rate (2) column. In actual PIK rows, the Interest Rate (2) cell shows a total rate followed by the PIK component in the same cell, such as 9.70% (4.00% PIK), 12.27% (2.50% PIK), and 9.45% (2.75% PIK). The non-PIK portion is the arithmetic remainder of the printed total less printed PIK, so the stated Interest Rate (2) means the all-in rate with PIK included.
